scope: Independent noise calibration and nuisance-aware family rejection in Gaussian thermal oscillators, not causal attribution or a response certificate
cost_rule: A calibration reading is one noise-only observation at a known zero reference. Each dynamic pair costs two readings. K=floor(B*fraction); dynamic pairs floor((B-K)/2) rounded down to a multiple 2*lag_count. Record used readings and lag-wait proxy N*(1+mean lag)+K; primary matching is total readings, not actual laboratory time.
calibration_rule: Independent zero-mean Gaussian calibration noise with same variance as dynamics, except the explicit transfer failure. Z=sum z_i^2; exact variance interval [Z/chi2_(1-beta/2,K), Z/chi2_(beta/2,K)]. Known zero mean implies K, not K-1, degrees of freedom.
sensor_alarm: Nominal noise variance 0.35^2 outside calibration interval; unavailable if K=0. This tests calibration noise only, not its stability during dynamics.
moment_rules: Exact chi-square coordinate intervals with a union bound over two coordinates at each lag. Naive fixes nominal variance, plug-in fixes Z/K without uncertainty, nuisance intersects common noise-variance intervals across all lags and both coordinates with independent calibration interval or [0,infinity) without calibration.
split_rule: Half-data arbitrary positive-definite zero-mean Gaussian fit at each lag forms a normalized alternative density. Null denominator upper bound independently maximizes each plus/minus coordinate variance over the range allowed by calibration; max over the three candidates. This relaxation is safe but may lose power. Without calibration use noise range [0,infinity).
mixture_reference: Reuse the 36-alternative fixed-mixture detector from benchmark 006 at assumed noise 0.35, as an explicitly noise-sensitive reference. It ignores calibration data.
alpha_rule: With calibration, nuisance moment and relaxed split use alpha_total-beta on dynamics and beta for calibration coverage, giving physical-null rejection at most alpha_total under transfer assumptions. Without calibration they use alpha_total. Naive, plug-in, fixed-mixture references use alpha_total but have no uniform unknown-noise guarantee.
holdout: Fresh physical shifts +/-4.1 and +/-11.3 percent, decays 0.13 and 0.27, and noise changes 0.28, 0.48, 0.65 replace inspected stress parameters. Frozen schedules and rules may not be retuned on these outcomes.
metrics: Per-cell Wilson 95 percent rejection intervals, calibration coverage, sensor alarm, joint four-way labels for calibrated nuisance methods, reference response error, and missed deviations above five percent reference-response error. A physics flag means inconsistency with the physical family plus the stated sensor assumptions; it is not a causal proof.
limits: Known stiffness and temperature, zero-mean Gaussian independent sensor errors, exact equilibrium preparation, independent pairs, and calibration transfer are assumed. No continuum response-confidence region, unknown-memory inference, nonlinear experiment, or new theory is claimed.
